AN HONOUR WE SHARE

Pride of
Punjab.

For our family, our team,
and everyone who has eaten with us.

Thank you to Punjab Tourism and the jury for this honour. And to our guests, who have kept coming back, brought their families, and made Kesar part of their visits to Amritsar.

We’re proud to keep serving the Punjabi food you know us for.
